where-possibility-meets.text: A dedicated platform connecting upstream mining, mineral processing, smart technology and high-value downstream opportunities.
One meeting place for the entire mining and downstream value chain.

Indonesia Mining & Downstream Industries Exhibition 2027 brings together industry players, technology providers and decision-makers to exchange ideas, explore partnerships and shape what's next for the sector.

Designed as a business-to-business exhibition, IMDX 2027 connects the sectors behind the industry's transformation — from exploration and extraction to mineral processing, metallurgy, automation, responsible mining and high-value downstream applications.

Exhibitors can introduce equipment, services and practical solutions to potential partners, while industry professionals can discover emerging technologies and exchange perspectives. Planned conference and networking activities provide further opportunities for dialogue and collaboration.

indonesia-a-core-hub-in-the.alt: Aerial view of a large industrial mineral processing complex

indonesia-a-core-hub-in-the.text: MINING & DOWNSTREAM INDUSTRIES**Turning resources into new possibilities.**

In recent years, the Indonesian government has continued to advance its mineral downstreaming strategy, including export restrictions on raw nickel, bauxite and tin concentrates and requirements for domestic smelting and processing. This has rapidly increased demand for smelting, beneficiation and deep-processing equipment. At the same time, mining areas are accelerating electrification and intelligent transformation, with photovoltaic microgrids and heavy-equipment electrification projects being deployed in major mining regions such as Sulawesi and Kalimantan. Indonesia's annual mining-equipment market has reached approximately US$2.5 billion, with continuing growth in demand for smart mining, green-mine construction and downstream processing equipment.
Source: organizer market overview (concept data — to be verified before publication).

a-world-of.text: / EXHIBITION SCOPE
EIGHT INDUSTRY CATEGORIES
A world of
opportunity.
From extraction at the source to applications that create new value. Explore the sectors represented at the exhibition.
**Mining Extraction Equipment & Technology**Mining machinery, drilling, hauling and underground solutions
Full-process equipment for open-pit and underground mining, including excavators, haulage trucks, loaders, roadheaders, drill rigs and material transport systems.
**Mineral Processing & Beneficiation**Crushing, grinding, screening and separation technologies
Processing and beneficiation equipment for crushing, grinding, classification, screening, flotation, filtration and material-handling operations.
**Metallurgy & Deep Processing**Smelting, refining, casting and high-value processing
Furnaces, converters, kilns, refining and smelting systems, metallurgy solutions, casting, rolling, heat treatment and advanced manufacturing.
**Downstream Materials & Applications**Nickel, copper, batteries and industrial applications
Nickel, copper, tin, aluminum, battery materials, stainless steel, alloys, industrial components and downstream partnership opportunities.
**Digital Intelligence & Automation**Smart mining, industrial data and automation
Digital intelligence, industrial IoT, monitoring, connected systems and automation. Details subject to organizer confirmation.
**Safety, Environment & Green Mining**Safer, cleaner and more sustainable operations
Safety equipment, environmental protection, green mine management and responsible operations. Details subject to organizer confirmation.
**Supporting Equipment & Consumables**Components, spare parts and critical support systems
Supporting equipment, spare parts, consumables and technologies for mining and downstream industrial facilities.
**Exploration, Engineering & Investment**Testing, services, financing and partnerships
Exploration, testing, project engineering, services and investment or financing support for the mining value chain.

make-your-next-connection.text: Three reasons to put your company in front of the people shaping coal, energy and mining cooperation between the two countries.

Government agencies, industry associations, leading energy companies, trade and investment bodies, and specialists in coal technology, equipment trade, geological exploration and engineering contracting from China and Indonesia — gathered on one high-level platform.

Bilateral coal and energy policy meets real business: coal trade, clean and low-carbon solutions such as coal preparation and coal chemicals, technology and equipment, coal and new-energy integration, and targeted project matchmaking across the whole value chain.
Learn from China–Indonesia coal and energy cooperation that already delivers results, and use it to open new collaboration across more sectors.
Showcase your capabilities, introduce your solutions and begin meaningful conversations with the industry.
Booth selection is subject to organizer confirmation.

the-venue.text:
JAKARTA INTERNATIONAL EXPO (JIEXPO), KEMAYORAN
HOME OF INDONESIA MINING & DOWNSTREAM INDUSTRIES EXHIBITION 2027

Jakarta International Expo (JIExpo) Kemayoran is located strategically in the heart of Jakarta, offering exceptional accessibility that makes it Indonesia’s premier destination for massive international trade shows, concerts, and conventions.

The landmark brings together thousands of industry professionals, exhibitors and buyers to accelerate networking and business opportunities. The venue offers familiarity amongst the food and beverage industry, with business facilitation, easy transportation access and spacious parking area.
Jakarta International Expo (JIExpo) Kemayoran is one of the leading venues in Jakarta, and provide the best solution for Meetings Convention Conference Exhibition (MICE) in Indonesia.

JIExpo Kemayoran has an area up to 44 hectares, with 100,000 sqm exhibition area, consist of 50,000 sqm of indoor and more than 50,000 sqm of open space or outdoor area. Over the years, JIEXPO has hosted various exhibitions and events across multi sectors.

questions.text: When and where will the event be held?
Indonesia Mining & Downstream Industries Exhibition 2027 is scheduled for 26–28 May 2027 at JIEXPO, Jakarta, Indonesia.
Can I request a specific booth size?

Yes. Sign in, choose preferred available units on the published floorplan and enter the area you need in m². Your selection is a request only — the organizer confirms the final booth, area and quotation.
How do I register for a conference?
Create a verified account and select a published conference. Paid bookings use a manually issued invoice and organizer-confirmed bank transfer.
Are payments available on this website?
Paid conference and booth bookings use organizer-issued invoices and manual bank transfers. Finance confirms payments in CMS; no automatic checkout is available.

privacy-notice.text: DRAFT FOR UAT — this notice is pending review and approval by the organizer's Legal team (decision D-12/D-13). It is not yet the final legal text.

When you create an account, register, request a booth, send a contact message or attend the event we process: your name, verified email or phone, company, job title and country; your registrations, booth requests, invoices and verified payments; your consent version and time; and check-in records at event gates.

To verify your account, manage registrations and booth requests, issue invoices for manual bank transfer, confirm payments, issue and validate personal QR passes, respond to enquiries and report anonymised attendance. Your QR code contains only a random token, never your name or contact details.

Only authorised organizer staff, according to their role (for example, Finance sees invoices and payments; gate staff see only what is needed to admit you). Exhibitor names are published on the floorplan only after approval.
Retention periods and the procedure for access, correction and deletion requests will be published here once approved. Until then, contact the organizer through the .

Paid conference seats and booths are invoiced by the organizer and paid by manual bank transfer to the account shown on your official invoice in your account. Uploading a transfer receipt does not confirm payment; Finance confirms receipt from the bank statement.

Choosing booths on the floorplan and entering a requested area is a request only. The organizer confirms booth units, area and price in a quotation you accept; booth allocation is confirmed separately by Operations.
